title: How to love someone whose love language is acts of service

slides.title: How to love someone whose love language is *acts of service*
Do the thing *before they ask.*
slides.body: The task they’ve been putting off all week? Done. Quietly.

slides.title: Make their coffee *exactly* right.
slides.body: Their mug, their milk, their sugar. Every single time.

slides.title: Handle one *adult thing.*
slides.body: A booking, a bill, that phone call they keep dodging.

slides.title: Refill the *small stuff.*
slides.body: Charge their phone. Fill the water bottle. Top up the gas.

slides.title: Take something *off their plate.*
slides.body: Ask what you can take on when they’re stressed. Then actually take it.

slides.title: Save this *for their next busy week.*
slides.sub: Then quietly start with number one.
